question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?
rendered: According to the document, at cycle 1500 at 1C, the cathode delivered 306 mAh/g. In the rate test, the cathode delivered 370 mAh/g at 1C. Therefore, the share of the capacity at cycle 1500 at 1C of the reversible capacity at 1C in the rate test is 306 mAh/g / 370 mAh/g = 0.828 or 82.8%.
